sentences.en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
sentences.zh: 鲨鱼对电脉冲和声音也很敏感。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a shark over three meters long?
sentences.zh: 你见过超过三米长的鲨鱼吗？

sentences.en: The whale shark is the largest shark in the world.
sentences.zh: 鲸鲨是世界上最大的鲨鱼。

senses.zh: 鲨鱼；坑蒙拐骗的人，诈骗者；俚老手
